Hi <customer_first_name>,

I wanted to reach out once again to welcome you to the <dealership_name> family! Your loyalty is important and I hope you felt you received the Red Carpet Experience we pride ourselves on. I hope you’re enjoying your new vehicle and I’m here to answer any questions if you need anything at all!

Also, you will be receiving a survey from <vehicle_of_interest_make>, if for any reason you cannot fill out this survey completely satisfied and definitely recommend, please call me or our General Manager, (name), at <dealership_phone>. 

Your experience means everything to me, so please be sure to leave some comments/recommendations on how I can do better! I also have a monthly goal of 10 Google Reviews, if you could help me out there it would be much appreciated! 

By the way, if you have any friends or family that may want to take advantage of the deal you received, please keep me in mind. I’ll be sure to take care of them!

Thanks again for your time and business,

<user_full_name>
<dealership_name>
<user_mobile_phone>
